text:
Ana Romero: Quick heads-up — this Friday's Spring Summit all-hands is at 10:00 AM PT in the main auditorium link: https://meet.redwood.ai/spring-summit. Agenda + ask doc: https://redwood.notion.site/Spring-Summit-Agenda-abc123. Please add any Qs by Thursday EOD. :wave:

Mike Chen: I'll demo Dedicated autoscale changes — need remote staging access, pinged @devops. :ok_hand:

Sarah Patel: Question — will we surface the new data retention policy during exec updates? customers asked about default retention.

Ana Romero: Short answer: yes, quick slide. TL;DR in meeting we'll outline default retention moving to 30 days for Hosted, with Dedicated/Private opt-outs; more in policy doc linked in agenda.

Jules: Uploaded two new slides for Platform SLOs and rollback runbook. Can someone review the wording? especially the "graceful fallback" section.

Lia: Requesting live captions — can we enable captions on the Meet link? accessibility check.

Nate: FYI incident recap (storage blip last week) posted here: https://redwood.status/2026-03-storage-brief — exec will touch on followups.

Mike Chen: Demo checklist I pushed to the demo doc. Small note: please mute Zoom notifications and close other GPU-heavy apps on demo machine. :sweat_smile:

Sarah Patel: Added a Q to the doc re: enterprise KMS integration timeline.

Ana Romero: Thanks all — I'll consolidate Qs into the order doc and send final 9:30 AM PT reminder. Recording will be posted after the meeting; if you can't attend, add any priority asks to the doc and we'll cover them live. :memo:

allhands-bot: Reminder scheduled: all-hands starts in 2 days at 10:00 AM PT. Recording will be uploaded automatically to the company drive within 60 minutes after the meeting. :bell:

Mike Chen: One more — can someone from Sales confirm a short customer success highlight? @Sarah Patel?

Sarah Patel: Yep, putting in a 90s customer vignette (SaaS integrator) — slides in the agenda doc.

Lia: Captions enabled and tested. :white_check_mark:

Ana Romero: Awesome. See you Friday. :rocket:
